meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 接入 GitHub，在仓库的 PR 和 issue 评论线程里参与对话：被 @ 提及时回复。首次提及后该线程被订阅，后续评论它都会跟进。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 到机器人账号（须与 GITHUB_BOT_USERNAME 完全一致）时触发；仓库 webhook 需订阅 Issue comments 与 Pull request review comments。

say.text: 看一下这个 PR 里的改动，指出潜在问题
say.note: 在 PR 评论中 @ 机器人后它会回复

say.text: 总结一下这个 issue 目前的讨论
say.note: 同一线程继续评论即可接着聊

say.text: 根据这条评论里的报错，给出修复思路

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins GitHub PR and issue comment threads via the Chat SDK bridge. It replies when @-mentioned; after the first mention the thread is subscribed and it follows up on later comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account (must match GITHUB_BOT_USERNAME exactly) in a PR or issue comment; the repo webhook must subscribe to issue and PR review comment events.

say_en.text: Look at the changes in this PR and flag potential problems.
say_en.note: Post it as a PR comment @-mentioning the bot

say_en.text: Summarize the discussion in this issue so far.
say_en.note: Keep commenting in the same thread to continue

say_en.text: Here is the error in this comment — suggest a fix.
say_en.note: The thread is subscribed, no need to @ again
